questions.question: A shopkeeper marks goods at a price that would give a 40% profit if sold entirely at marked price. He sells 80% of the goods at marked price, 15% at a 20% discount on marked price, and the remaining 5% at a 40% discount on marked price. Find his overall profit percentage.

A factory's production increases by 10% p.a. for 2 years, then decreases by 20% in the third year, then increases by 25% in the fourth year. If production 4 years ago was 8,000 units, find current production.
A's salary is 20% more than B's, B's is 25% more than C's, and C's is 10% less than D's. If D earns Rs. 50,000, find A's salary.
Due to a 25% hike in onion prices, a family reduces consumption so that expenditure rises by only 10%. If original monthly consumption was 20 kg, find the new monthly consumption.
questions.explanation: New consumption factor = 1.10/1.25 = 0.88. New consumption = 20 x 0.88 = 17.6 kg.

questions.question: A trader buys goods at a 20% discount on the list price. He sells the goods at exactly the list price after allowing a 10% discount on his own marked price, still earning a 25% profit on cost. Find his marked price as a percentage of the list price (to 2 decimal places).
questions.explanation: List price=100. CP=100x0.80=80. Required SP = 80x1.25 = 100 (the list price). MPx0.90=100 => MP=111.11, i.e. 111.11% of the list price.

questions.question: A number is successively increased by 10%, 20%, and 30% in three stages. Find the single equivalent percentage increase (to 2 decimal places).
questions.explanation: Factor = 1.10 x 1.20 x 1.30 = 1.716, i.e. a 71.6% net increase.

questions.question: A 120-litre mixture has milk and water in the ratio 7:3. A trader sells 40% of the mixture, then adds pure milk equal to 20% of the remaining mixture's volume. Find the new percentage of milk in the final mixture.
questions.explanation: Milk=84L, Water=36L. Selling 40% (48L) removes milk:water in 7:3, i.e. 33.6L milk and 14.4L water. Remaining: milk=50.4L, water=21.6L, total=72L. Add pure milk = 20% of 72 = 14.4L. New milk=64.8L, new total=86.4L. Milk% = 64.8/86.4 x100 = 75%.

questions.question: A's expenditure is 75% of his income. His income grows by 18% while his expenditure grows by 22%. Find the percentage change in his savings.
questions.explanation: Assume income=100, expenditure=75, savings=25. New income=118, new expenditure=75x1.22=91.5, new savings=26.5. Change = (1.5/25)x100 = 6% increase.

questions.question: A container has 100 litres of pure alcohol. 20% is drawn off and replaced with water; this is repeated two more times. Find the final alcohol concentration (to 2 decimal places).
Alloy A has copper:zinc = 5:3, and Alloy B has copper:zinc = 1:2. If 8 kg of Alloy A is mixed with 4 kg of Alloy B, find the percentage of copper in the resulting mixture (to 2 decimal places).
questions.explanation: Alloy A: copper=8x(5/8)=5kg. Alloy B: copper=4x(1/3)=1.333kg. Total copper=6.333kg out of 12kg total. Copper% = 6.333/12 x100 ≈ 52.78%.

questions.question: A's income is 30% more than B's, and B's income is 30% more than C's. By what percentage is A's income more than C's?
A shopkeeper raises the price of an item by 25% while also reducing the quantity given per sale unit by 20%. Find the effective percentage increase in price per kg actually sold.
questions.explanation: Effective price per kg = new price/new weight fraction = 1.25/0.80 = 1.5625, i.e. a 56.25% effective increase.

questions.question: An investment of Rs. 2,00,000 grows by 20% in year 1. The investor then withdraws 10% of the year-end value, and the remainder grows by 25% in year 2. Find the value at the end of year 2.
In a survey, 70% liked Product A, 60% liked Product B, and 50% liked both. What percentage liked neither product?
A salary increases by 10% every year. After how many complete years will it first exceed double the original salary? (1.1^7 = 1.9487, 1.1^8 = 2.1436)
questions.explanation: 1.1^7 = 1.9487 < 2, but 1.1^8 = 2.1436 > 2. So the salary first exceeds double after 8 complete years.

questions.question: A firm's revenue splits between Products X and Y in the ratio 3:2. Next year, X's revenue grows 15% while Y's declines 10%. Find the overall percentage growth in total revenue.
A car's total price includes a 28% tax on its pre-tax price. If the total price paid is Rs. 3,20,000, find the pre-tax price and the tax amount.
A gets 20% more than B, and C gets 20% less than B. If the combined salary of all three is Rs. 87,000, find each person's salary.
A student's score improved from 60% to 78% across two attempts, while the maximum marks increased from 500 to 600 between attempts. Find the actual increase in marks obtained.
questions.explanation: First attempt = 0.60x500 = 300. Second attempt = 0.78x600 = 468. Increase = 468-300 = 168 marks.

questions.question: A unit's cost consists of 40% raw material, 35% labour, and 25% overheads. Raw material costs rise 20%, labour costs rise 10%, and overheads stay unchanged. Find the overall percentage increase in total cost.
